title: Tap Foam Waste Rate
app: Brewfather batch exports, iSpindel and Tilt hydrometers, ESPHome mash probes, keg pressure sensors, brew-fridge telemetry, and cellar climate data via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kegerator:pour
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(waste_oz) as waste_oz, sum(poured_oz) as poured_oz by tap _time
| eval waste_pct=round(100*waste_oz/poured_oz,1)
| where poured_oz>0 AND waste_pct>10
| sort - waste_pct
description: Uses Kegerator pour telemetry telemetry to monitor how much draft beer is turning into foam waste in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for tap lines or settings that are hurting serving yield, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Kegerator pour telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Weekly tap table of foam-waste percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how much draft beer is turning into foam waste so you can spot tap lines or settings that are hurting serving yield before it becomes annoying.
